_comment: Reusable struct pack for Vector MICROSAR Dem NV data. SEMANTICS ONLY: field byte layout (incl. array sizes such as EventStatus[<event count>], ExtendedData[n][m]) always comes from the project's own generated Dem_Lcfg.h, so this one file fits every project regardless of its event count or record sizes. Patches for fields a project's Dem config compiled out (STD_OFF members) are ignored. Use: declare it as a source relative to your descriptor and list it in options.structs.packs, e.g. sources: { "demLcfg": "Dem_Lcfg.h", "demStructs": "../../../vector/dem/vector-dem.nvmstructs.json" }, options.structs: { fromSources: ["demLcfg"], packs: ["demStructs"] }. Requires the descriptor to declare the `demLcfg` source (Dem_Lcfg.h); declare `nvmCfg` (NvM_Cfg.c) too so the trailing CMAC/CRC is never decoded as data.

enumsFromDefines._comment: AUTOSAR DEM event-id table (#define DemConf_DemEventParameter_<NAME> <id>u) -> DemEventName, so event ids and EventStatus indices show their symbolic name.

DemUdsStatus.name: DemUdsStatus
DemUdsStatus._comment: ISO 14229-1 DTC status byte, bit index -> label (used with format.kind = bitflags).

Dem_Cfg_StatusDataType.name: Dem_Cfg_StatusDataType
